title: Boy crouching with pet dog, 1940s B&W snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white vintage snapshot dated July 31, 1949, featuring a young boy crouching on a dirt driveway and gently holding his fluffy pet dog. The boy is wearing a striped collared shirt and cuffed trousers typical of mid-century American casual fashion. Behind him, the background shows a wooden house with porch steps, outbuildings, and farm equipment spread across a rural Midwestern landscape.
